page.title: Connection Monitoring
page.description: How the connection is tested, and how the watchdog brings it back: re-registration, radio restart, the other SIM, reboot.

connectivity.title: Connectivity Status
connectivity.description: The last round of checks; system_bridge runs one every 10 seconds while a page is open (only the pings otherwise).

portal_alert.title: Captive portal detected
portal_alert.body: {{url}} answered with HTTP {{code}} instead of 204 No Content: the network is intercepting web traffic with a login, billing or activation page. Open any http:// site from a device on the LAN to see it; until it is accepted, data may be blocked or limited.
portal_alert.body_redirect: {{url}} answered with HTTP {{code}} and a redirect to <location>{{location}}</location> instead of 204 No Content: the network is intercepting web traffic with a login, billing or activation page. Open any http:// site from a device on the LAN to see it; until it is accepted, data may be blocked or limited.

checks.title: Connectivity Checks
checks.description: What the dashboard's internet status tests: pings, DNS lookups written as server:domain, and an http:// URL that must answer 204 No Content (anything else means a captive portal; empty disables it). They run every 10 seconds while a page is open.
checks.bg_interval_hint: How often the pings run while no page is open (10 to 600, in steps of 10), and the step of the 24-hour latency history. They use mobile data: about 3 MB a day at 10 s, 0.5 MB a day at 60 s.

errors.http_probe: Captive portal probe: an http:// URL (letters, digits and . _ ~ / ? = % - only), or empty to disable it.
errors.bg_interval: Background check interval: 10 to 600 seconds, in steps of 10.

latency.title: Latency, Last 24 Hours
latency.description_one: Average ping time of the targets above per {{count}} minute. system_bridge keeps one sample every {{every}}, the background check interval, also while no page is open.
latency.description_other: Average ping time of the targets above per {{count}} minutes. system_bridge keeps one sample every {{every}}, the background check interval, also while no page is open.

status.title: Watchdog Status
status.description: What the watchdog is doing now, refreshed every 5 seconds.
status.failover_revert: On SIM {{slot}} since {{since}}, SIM {{original}} again at {{at}}

activity.title: Recovery Activity
activity.description: Every step the watchdog took, newest first (kept in memory until the next reboot).
activity.empty_description: Recovery steps appear here when the watchdog acts on an outage.

settings.title: Watchdog Settings
settings.description: When the connection counts as lost, and the recovery ladder that follows: from the gentlest step to a reboot. Takes effect as soon as it is saved.
settings.targets_hint: IPv4 addresses, comma separated: a check passes when any of them answers.
settings.boot_grace_hint: No recovery in the first seconds after a boot.
settings.recovery_intro: Tried in order. Each step waits its settle time for the connection to come back before the next one runs; disabled steps are skipped.

tier1.name: Re-register to the network
tier1.description: Detach and attach again; a manually chosen operator is kept.

tier2.name: Restart the radio
tier2.description: RF off, then on again. The SIM stays powered.
tier2.attempts_hint: Before moving to the next step.

tier3.name: Switch to the other SIM
tier3.description: Kept only when the SIM in the other slot answers READY; an empty slot is left alone for 6 hours.
tier3.revert_timer_hint: Back to the original SIM after a while; if it is still offline, the other SIM returns.
tier3.revert_never_hint: Until you switch back in Cellular Settings.

tier4.name: Reboot the modem
tier4.description: The last resort, within the daily reboot limit.

settings.max_hour_hint: Every tier counts; beyond it the watchdog only watches.
settings.cooldown_hint: After a ladder ends, before another may start.

errors.targets: Enter one or more IPv4 targets, comma separated.
errors.no_tier: Enable at least one recovery tier.

errors.config_read_failed: Unable to read the watchdog configuration
errors.activity_read_failed: Unable to read the watchdog activity
